_doc: Every knob the demo run depends on. run_demo.py reads this file and nothing else; the hash of this file is recorded in the evidence bundle so a run can be tied to its configuration.

tokenizer.name: sarvam1
tokenizer._provenance: Inherited from S4 (models/tokenizer-sarvam1.json), the same 68,096-entry vocab the S5 proxy ablation trained on. Frozen here: the demo never retrains or extends it.

lanes._doc: Capability lanes. 'origin' records whether the documents are inherited from S4's cleaned corpus or generated locally, because S4's Sangraha corpus only covers Indic and English web text.

corpus._doc: Document counts drawn per lane. Small on purpose: the goal is a correct, auditable data system, not scale. The code and reasoning counts are sized so their supply covers demand after S5's 60% OPUS rejection rate without exceeding the epoch ceiling -- the 'collect more' response to a compiler shortfall warning. Agentic is deliberately left short: widget 7 found agentic runs out under every curriculum profile, and pretending otherwise by generating 3,000 synthetic trajectories would hide the one supply constraint the session says is real.

eval_firewall._doc: Four independent checks, each contributing its own clause to a rejection reason. See tds/firewall.py.

mixture._doc: Lane weights, protected floors and the anneal reserve are read from S5's data/ledger.json (mirrored into fixtures/upstream/s5_ledger.json) and collapsed onto the three curriculum stages the S6 session uses.
mixture._budget_note: 276480 = train.total_steps (180) x microbatches_per_step (4) x microbatch_size (2) x sequence_length (192). The planned budget and what the run actually consumes are the same number on purpose, so planned-versus-actual mixture shares are a real comparison rather than a rescaled one. Stage boundaries sit at 55% and 85% of the budget, the same split widget 7 uses for its 0-66B / 66-102B / 102-120B timeline.

stage_weights._doc: S5's main mixture bent across the three stages: web falls, code/reasoning climb, Indic doubles into the anneal reserve. Lanes S5 carries but S6 does not model (stem, long_context) are folded into web and reasoning respectively.

opus._doc: Deterministic selector. The proxy score is derived from the candidate's content hash crossed with lane/stage/model-age priors -- never from an RNG that advances with training, or replay would not reproduce.

model._doc: Tiny NumPy transformer, hand-written forward and backward. Small enough for a CPU demo, large enough that per-token loss deltas by lane are meaningful. projected_vocab_size is the model output width, not the tokenizer: the 68,096-entry vocab is projected onto its 6,144 most frequent ids (about 89% of corpus token occurrences) so the logit tensor stays small. Shards, ledger events and batch hashes always use real tokenizer ids -- see tds/vocab.py.

recovery._doc: The crash is a real os._exit(1) in a training subprocess, so the resuming process rebuilds from the checkpoint and ledger on disk only. If the whole demo shared one process, 'expected == actual' would be trivially true.
